source.organization: General Authority for Islamic Affairs, Endowments and Zakat
source.methodology: Counting and classifying Quran education centers by type based on administrative records during the specified period

indicator.name: Number of Quran education centers by type
indicator.definition: Total number of Quran education centers classified by center type during the specified period

center_name.description: Official name of the Quran memorization center (in Arabic)

branch.description: The city/region where the center is located (e.g. Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Dubai)

emirate.description: The UAE emirate the center falls under administratively

area.description: The specific neighborhood or district within the city (in Arabic)

center_type.description: Classification of the center: Government, Endowment (Waqf), Private, or Rented

latitude.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the center (where available)

longitude.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the center (where available)

terms.definition: Accredited educational institutions for teaching and memorizing the Holy Quran for all age groups
terms.calculation: Total number of Quran memorization centers for all age groups

terms.definition: Classification of the center by ownership/funding: Government (حكومي), Endowment/Waqf (وقف), Private (خاص), or Rented (مستأجر)
Digital address of the place on the globe, precisely determining its location using latitude and longitude
terms.calculation: Total number of centers by location
